import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open('/dev/null').read()) if False else None

V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rw=B62.strip().split('\n');AA=rw[0].split();idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
MAT=np.full((21,21),-4.)
for r_ in rw[1:]:
    p=r_.split()
    for b,v in zip(AA,p[1:]): MAT[idx[p[0]],idx[b]]=float(v)
MAT=np.vstack([MAT,np.full((1,21),-4.)]); MAT=np.hstack([MAT,np.full((22,1),-4.)])
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s],dtype=int)
def scan(we,se):
    L=len(we);M=len(se)
    if M<L: return -1e9,0
    sc=np.zeros(M-L+1)
    for k in range(L): sc+=MAT[we[k], se[k:M-L+1+k]]
    b=int(np.argmax(sc)); return sc[b],b
HS=''.join(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96QU6.fasta',timeout=60).text.strip().split('\n')[1:])
POS={'Y132':132,'W135':135,'H201':201,'K323':323,'R351':351,'R457':457}; HALF=14
WE={k:(enc(HS[max(0,p-HALF-1):p+HALF]), p-max(1,p-HALF)) for k,p in POS.items()}
def bulk(q):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={'query':q,'size':500,'fields':'accession,organism_name,length,sequence','format':'tsv'},timeout=180)
    open('/tmp/b.tsv','w').write(r.text)
    try: return pd.read_csv('/tmp/b.tsv',sep='\t')
    except Exception: return pd.DataFrame()
PN='protein_name:"1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate synthase-like protein 1"'
clades={'Actinopterygii':7898,'Mammalia':40674,'Sauropsida':8457,'Amphibia':8292,'Chondrichthyes':7777,'Cyclostomata':1476529}
fr=[]
for c,tx in clades.items():
    d=bulk(f'{PN} AND taxonomy_id:{tx} AND length:[440 TO 780]')
    if len(d): d['clade']=c; fr.append(d)
ALL=pd.concat(fr,ignore_index=True).sort_values('Length',ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['Organism']).reset_index(drop=True)
rows=[]
for _,r in ALL.iterrows():
    s=r['Sequence']
    if not isinstance(s,str) or len(s)<400: continue
    se=enc(s); o={'acc':r['Entry'],'organism':r['Organism'],'clade':r['clade'],'len':r['Length']}
    for k,(we,off) in WE.items():
        sc,b=scan(we,se); o[k]=s[b+off]; o[k+'_sc']=sc
    rows.append(o)
P=pd.DataFrame(rows)
P.to_csv('/agent/jobs/a9523a43-994d-4a5f-9d14-987fcc00fedb/provenance/accs_position_survey.csv',index=False)
Pc=P[P.R351_sc>=45]
print(f'surveyed {len(P)} species; {len(Pc)} with confident R351 window')
tab=pd.crosstab(Pc.clade,Pc.R351)
print('\nResidue at the hACCS Arg351 column:\n', tab.to_string())
print('\n%% Arg by clade:')
for cl in tab.index:
    n=tab.loc[cl].sum(); r=tab.loc[cl].get('R',0)
    print(f'  {cl:16s} n={n:3d}  Arg={r:3d} ({100*r/n:5.1f}%)')
print('\nInvariance of each position across all surveyed vertebrates:')
summ=[]
for k,p in POS.items():
    q=P[P[k+'_sc']>=45]; wt=HS[p-1]
    pct=100*(q[k]==wt).mean(); summ.append((k,len(q),pct,collections.Counter(q[k]).most_common(4)))
    print(f'  {k}: n={len(q):3d}  identical to human = {pct:5.1f}%   top: {collections.Counter(q[k]).most_common(4)}')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
order=[c for c in ['Mammalia','Sauropsida','Amphibia','Actinopterygii','Chondrichthyes','Cyclostomata'] if c in tab.index]
t2=tab.loc[order]; n_by=t2.sum(axis=1); t2p=t2.div(n_by,axis=0)*100
cols=[c for c in t2p.sum().sort_values(ascending=False).index]
t2p[cols].plot(kind='barh',stacked=True,ax=ax,colormap='tab20',width=.7)
for i,cl in enumerate(order): ax.text(101,i,f'n={int(n_by[cl])}',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,115); ax.set_xlabel('% of species'); ax.set_ylabel('')
ax.set_title('Residue at the human ACCS Arg351 column\n(side pocket, contributed in trans)',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(ncol=6,fontsize=7,loc='lower right',frameon=False,title=None)
ax=axes[1]
labs=[s[0] for s in summ]; vals=[s[2] for s in summ]
colors=['#38a169' if l in('Y132','W135') else '#2b6cb0' if l in('K323','R457') else '#d69e2e' if l=='R351' else '#c53030' for l in labs]
b=ax.bar(labs,vals,color=colors)
for bb,v,s in zip(b,vals,summ): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,v+1.5,f'{v:.0f}%\nn={s[1]}',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0,118); ax.set_ylabel('% of vertebrate species identical to human ACCS')
ax.set_title('Catalytic and PLP residues are invariant;\nthe side-pocket Arg351 is mammal-restricted',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
